invariants.rationale: If the item is not contained in the list and selection is required only when items has size > 0, only then can selection be null.

invariants.expression: selection.get() == item || (selection.getRequired() && items.size > 0 && selection.get() == items.first()) || (!selection.getRequired() || items.size <= 0) && selection.get() == null
invariants.rationale: After setSelected, either the selected item is the given item, or if item not found but selection is required and items not empty, select first; else selection is null.
If item is not in items, selection can only proceed in certain cases, matching method logic.
Selection is always either null (if not required or no items) or an element in items.
If selection is required and items is not empty, there must be a non-null selection.
